observations: Photo 0 shows a single wooden slat pallet lying on concrete, with a second pallet partially visible in the top right corner.
Photo 1 shows the same single wooden pallet from a similar angle; all photos carry the watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GOLDNEST'.
Photo 2 shows multiple stacks of wooden pallets indoors or under a shed, arranged in neat vertical piles.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a wooden slat pallet of typical storage design; photo 2 shows multiple similar pallets stacked.

risks.risk: Hidden rot, cracks, or broken slats on faces not shown or inside the stacks.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all four sides and the underside of a sample pallet, or a video of the pallet being lifted and turned.

risks.risk: Contamination from prior cargo (chemicals, food residue, pests) that is not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: Seller statement or inspection clip showing clean, dry pallets and disclosure of prior use.

risks.risk: Exact quantity and whether the stacked pallets in photo 2 match the condition of the single pallet in photo 0/1.
risks.proof: Counted stack photo with a measuring tape, or a video panning across the full stock.
risks.if_unproven: as one pallet only or a mismatched lot.

risks.risk: Dimensions not confirmed; the pallet could be a non-standard size.
risks.proof: Tape measure shot showing length, width, and height of the pallet.

proof_requests: Tape measure across the pallet in photo 0 to confirm dimensions.
Video or photos of the underside and side profile of the stacked pallets in photo 2.
Count of pallets in the stack shown in photo 2.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a wooden storage pallet from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst-case condition while hidden damage, quantity, and exact size remain unverified.
